title: Boolean sum over the false value
statement: For every nonnegative extended real number $p$, the sum over the false element of the Boolean set, restricted to the Boolean value that is false, of the weight that is $p$ at true and $1-p$ at false equals $1-p$.
hypotheses_covered: $p$ is a nonnegative extended real number
